title: Rules on Loans Extended by Temasek Holdings, GIC or Their Subsidiaries to Large Corporations
what_it_is: Rules on Loans Extended by Temasek Holdings, GIC or Their Subsidiaries to Large Corporations

sections.label: GIC and Temasek investments
sections.summary: GIC and Temasek invest using equity and debt, provide loans in an investment context but not mortgage or working capital loans, and the Government does not direct their investment decisions.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: GIC and Temasek invest using a variety of instruments, including equity and debt.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: GIC and Temasek can and do provide loans, where the loans are provided in the investment context.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: However, they do not provide the same loans as banks or finance companies do, that is to say, they do not provide mortgage loans or working capital loans which banks provide.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government does not direct GIC’s and Temasek’s individual investment decisions, including decisions as to whether, when or in whom to invest in a loan.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The President’s concurrence is not needed for investment decisions by GIC or Temasek.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The Government ensures that GIC and Temasek have competent Boards, and such appointments are subject to the President’s concurrence.

sections.label: Rescue package assumption wrong
sections.summary: The Member's phrasing of the question, which assumes they provide a rescue package to support viability, is a wrong assumption.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The way the Member has phrased the question, which is when they provide a rescue package to support viability, that is a wrong assumption.

sections.label: Commercial decisions by professionals
sections.summary: The commercial principles and decisions are taken by professionals employed by GIC and Temasek.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: The commercial principles – and these are all commercial decisions – these are decisions that are taken by their professionals which are employed by GIC and Temasek.
